about.text: An industrial Italian cheese created by Egidio Galbani in 1906 and named after Antonio Stoppani’s book Il Bel Paese, whose author’s portrait appears on the wrapper. It is made from pasteurised cow’s milk and ripened for six to eight weeks, giving a mild, creamy cheese with 45–50% fat in dry matter.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.
